api_version: BKG VG250 31.12.2025 UTM32s GeoPackage Ebenen ZIP original published MD5 sidecar only

request_contract.parameter_rules: Exactly one read-only fixed HTTPS GET for one public original publisher MD5 sidecar, no credentials, redirects, query, freeform host, path, provider version, operator-selected size, retries, arbitrary headers or unreviewed bulk ZIP retrieval. Refuse responses above 128 bytes. This small sidecar is not the full ZIP (about 67 MB) and /aktuell/ can be re-pointed by the provider. Any MD5 or filename drift blocks rather than silently accepts a new 2026 vintage.

response_contract.format: Single GNU md5sum-like ASCII record (publisher ZIP MD5 hex followed by exactly one prescribed ZIP basename), measured response approximately 69 bytes; no original ZIP, geometry or coordinate data.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: Strict 2025 official product reference and published checksum sidecar only. An MD5 value copied from a publisher sidecar is a claim about the whole ZIP, not a verified whole-file SHA-256, GPKG SQLite integrity, 2025 temporal-vintage confirmation inside the archive, valid national boundaries, coastline-versus-land GF2/GF4 mapping or CAT input. Compare independently to immutable BKG 2022 source, Natural Earth v5.1.1 and geoBoundaries DEU ADM1 2021 without silently merging vintages.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: Official BKG product page offers public no-auth direct download, under its DL-DE BY 2.0 terms. Limit probe to one fixed metadata file, at most once on trusted-main workflow merge or manual dispatch; no schedule, crawler, bulk ZIP request or entire WFS. An individual public GET is not global unmetered-API permission.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Official product metadata shows stand 31.12.2025 updated 10 June 2026. Public /aktuell/ alias is mutable; the reviewed sidecar publishes ZIP MD5 e6b4cf28d4b83557b4d6e3236713dec0, which is only MD5, NOT the missing complete original 2025 ZIP SHA-256. Bind original sidecar response byte count + SHA-256/UTC; future mismatch requires fresh exact-version/license/source review.

rights_and_policy.notes: Official BKG product page advertises anonymous direct downloads for everyone, with source-specific Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0 allowing commercial data reuse with mandatory prominent BKG/year, licence link, source-data contributors and alteration notice. This permission is scoped here to one tiny public sidecar GET; no separate unauthenticated bulk-crawling, rate-limit exemption, raw Git publication or CAT scientific admission is inferred.

expected_evidence: one fixed BKG HTTPS 200 response, no redirects or credentials
strict at-most-128-byte original sidecar response, publisher checksum/filename identity
original metadata body byte size and SHA-256; provider ZIP MD5 value separately labeled
UTC observation; source path pinned to published /aktuell/ and drift refused
no original ZIP download and no raw provider bytes persisted
model_input_approved=false; independent border truth not established
